2607.26473.title: Learning Dynamic User Personas from Implicit Interaction Streams via Iterative Refinement
2607.26473.paper_summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual users is essential for improving user experience, yet existing approaches typically rely on explicit preference supervision such as pairwise comparisons or demographic attributes, limiting their applicability in natural interaction settings. We propose IRIS, a framework that learns dynamic user personas directly from implicit interaction streams by extracting behavioral signals from everyday conversations and iteratively refining persona representations through a prediction-driven closed loop without requiring explicit feedback. We introduce an evaluation protocol based on behavior prediction, persona stability, and decision prediction. A proof-of-concept study on a synthetic interaction stream derived from public-domain autobiographical text shows that IRIS produces stable personas and distinguishes individual users while revealing limitations of memory-only approaches on recall-oriented metrics. We then validate IRIS on anonymized real-world Reddit r/AmItheAsshole (AITA) data, with personas built solely from each author's historical interactions. Across 100 authors, IRIS achieves the highest decision prediction accuracy among all evaluated methods (61.0%), outperforming static personas, memory-only retrieval, and no-personalization baselines. These results suggest that implicit behavioral modeling provides a scalable alternative to explicit preference learning for personalized LLMs and offers a practical foundation for adaptive conversational systems and embodied agents that require continuously evolving models of their users.
2607.26473.paper_summary_zh: 個性化大型語言模型（LLMs）以適應個別用戶對改善用戶體驗至關重要，然而現有的方法通常依賴於明確的偏好監督，例如成對比較或人口統計特徵，這限制了它們在自然互動環境中的適用性。<lb/>我們提出了IRIS，一個從隱式互動流中直接學習動態用戶角色的框架，通過提取日常對話中的行為信號，並通過以預測為驅動的閉環不斷精煉角色表示，而不需要明確的反饋。<lb/>我們引入了一種基於行為預測、角色穩定性和決策預測的評估協議。<lb/>在一項基於公共領域自傳文本衍生的合成互動流的概念驗證研究中，顯示IRIS生成穩定的角色並區分個別用戶，同時揭示了僅依賴記憶的方法在回憶導向指標上的局限性。<lb/>然後，我們在匿名的現實世界Reddit r/AmItheAsshole (AITA) 數據上驗證IRIS，角色完全基於每位作者的歷史互動構建。<lb/>在100位作者中，IRIS在所有評估方法中實現了最高的決策預測準確率（61.0%），超越了靜態角色、僅依賴記憶的檢索和無個性化的基準。<lb/>這些結果表明，隱式行為建模為個性化LLMs提供了一種可擴展的替代方案，並為需要不斷演變的用戶模型的自適應對話系統和具身代理提供了實用的基礎。
